items.prompt: What does a Python virtual environment directly provide?

options.text: A guaranteed identical copy of every external data source
options.why: It does not snapshot remote data.

options.text: A guarantee that every OS and CPU give identical numerical output
A substitute for recording the tested Python version
options.why: You still need to record the actual runtime.

options.text: A project-specific environment for installed Python packages
options.why: It helps isolate package installations, not an entire machine.

items.explanation: A venv isolates packages around a Python installation. Full reproduction still needs source, runtime, dependencies, data and relevant platform assumptions.
